changelog:
Add optional per-user entertainment channel profiles with global all-channel inheritance
Load available entertainment channel IDs from the selected area in the configuration page and API
Capture the selected channel policy at playback startup for consistent session behavior
Constrain channel capture, cinema dimming, color streaming, and light restoration to the selected channels
Report active channel selection diagnostics without exposing credentials
Add regression coverage for channel parsing, validation, persistence, filtered state capture, runtime resolution, channel discovery, and status/API wiring
See CHANGELOG.md for the complete release history
description: Synchronize Philips Hue lights with your media playback in real-time.
name: Philips Hue Sync
overview: Adds support for real-time lighting synchronization with Philips Hue Entertainment Areas using the streaming DTLS API. Features cinema mode, scene restoration, per-user bridge mappings, playback performance, color scene, execution, channel, and restoration profiles, advanced color processing, and auto-reconnection.
